config.iceandfire_dreadland.common.title: Ice And Fire: Dread Land - Config
config.iceandfire_dreadland.lightningDes: Destructive Thunderstorm: More lightning, Fire/Block/Item destruction
As dread sweeps across the mortal realm once more, has the savior of legend finally appeared?
item.iceandfire_dreadland.fireland_key.t: After the Dreadland was sealed away, its key was split into three parts and entrusted to three churches. When the three keys become one again, the gate to the Dreadland will open, and dread will sweep across the mortal realm once more!
